domain: business demography - establishment exit prediction from directory snapshots (Mexico)
prediction_question: Hypothetical task this source would support (NOT constructible from what INEGI publishes today): for an active economic establishment (a DENUE unit identified by the cross-version stable ID), given its snapshot attributes - SCIAN activity sector, municipality, size stratum by personnel, age since incorporation - will it have exited the directory by the next semiannual DENUE edition?
prediction_time: Would be the publication date of a DENUE edition: the current snapshot's attributes are knowable, the next edition is not yet published. The label is the absence of the stable ID from the next edition - a derived-inference label, not a registered legal event.
target_definition: Would be: stable DENUE ID present in edition V+1 (survived) vs absent (exited). Requires at least 2 downloadable editions; at least 4 for three disjoint diff-windows. Only 1 edition is downloadable (measured).

sources.name: Current DENUE bulk download (per-sector national zips)
sources.api: 25 national per-activity-sector CSV zips (sector codes 11, 21, 22, 23, 31-33, 43, 46111, 46112-46311, 46321-46531, 46591-46911, 48-49, 51, 52, 53, 54, 55, 56, 61, 62, 71, 72_1, 72_2, 81_1, 81_2, 93). Anonymous. Each zip holds conjunto_de_datos (CSV), diccionario_de_datos, metadatos.
sources.access: measured 2026-10-21 (probe_denue.py): all 25 URLs are REAL zips (PK magic on ranged GET; INEGI soft-404s unknown paths with HTTP 200 HTML, so magic bytes - not status - are the probe for this publisher). Measured total 571,891,279 B (572 MB) compressed for the current edition.

sources.name: DENUE editions documentation (INEGI RNM study catalogue)
sources.api: Documents semiannual editions since 2019 (05/2019, 11/2019, ..., 05/2024, 11/2024 - ~12 editions), the establishment counts per edition (5,564,612 in 05/2024; 6,058,548 in 11/2024), and that 'se mantiene la publicación de la clave ID del DENUE para identificar a cada establecimiento y, como factor vinculante de los datos entre las diferentes versiones publicadas' - the ID is the cross-version linking key, which is what an exit panel would be built on.
sources.access: fetched 2026-10-21; the catalogue's 'Descarga masiva' link points at the Descarga Masiva app (www.inegi.org.mx/app/descarga/?ti=6), which serves the CURRENT edition only.

sources.name: INEGI Descarga Masiva app
sources.api: SPA behind an undocumented JSON API (/app/api/descarga/descarga/descargamasiva/lista/obtenerlistado - POST with a JSON body of filter params; minimal param attempts answer 'Ocurrio un error, ver los detalles'). Not needed: the direct masiva URLs serve the current edition.

license_evidence.note: INEGI Términos de Libre Uso de la Información (fetched 2026-10-21): 'Puede hacer y distribuir copias de la información... Puede difundir y publicar la información... Puede adaptar y reordenar la información... Puede extraer total o parcialmente la información... Puede explotar comercialmente la información, utilizándola como insumo para generar otros productos o servicios. Debe otorgar los créditos correspondientes al INEGI como autor, y cuando técnicamente sea posible, mencionar la fuente... "Fuente: INEGI, nombre del producto de donde se extrae la información"'. Licence is settled (free use incl. commercial, attribution required, no official-posture implication) and is NOT the blocker.

split_strategy: NOT SATISFIABLE (measured): the exit label requires diffing consecutive DENUE editions, but only the CURRENT edition is downloadable. Split capacity fails - there is no second observation, hence no label and no train/eval/holdout windows. Split-capacity failure recorded rather than assumed: historical-edition URL patterns (2015/, 2019/, denue_2019_00_, denue_05_2024_00_ variants) all return INEGI's HTML error page behind HTTP 200, and a deliberately bogus filename returns the same - proving the soft-404 pattern and the absence of prior editions on that channel.

measurements.current_edition_bulk_2026_10_21: probe_denue.py: 25/25 per-sector zips real (PK magic), measured total 571,891,279 B compressed; per-sector sizes recorded in the probe output (largest: 46111 59,835,497 B; smallest: 55 58,074 B).
measurements.historical_absence_2026_10_21: Variant URL patterns for prior editions (2019/, 2015/, denue_2019_00_, denue_05_2024_00_) and a bogus control filename (zzz_nonexistent.zip) ALL answer HTTP 200 + HTML error page - identical soft-404 behavior, verified by first-bytes check rather than status. No historical DENUE edition found on any probed INEGI path; the Descarga Masiva app lists the current edition only.
measurements.descarga_app_api_2026_10_21: POST obtenerlistado with minimal JSON params -> 'Ocurrio un error, ver los detalles' (endpoint requires the SPA's full filter vocabulary; not pursued further because the direct masiva URLs already serve the current edition).
measurements.editions_documented_2026_10_21: RNM catalogue pages (924, 979) and press bulletins document ~12 semiannual editions 2019-2024 with per-edition establishment counts (e.g. DENUE 05/2024: 5,564,612; 11/2024: 6,058,548 establishments) - the editions EXIST as described but are not published for download.

rejection_reason: PARK (status parked), reason: SPLIT CAPACITY UNBUILDABLE from what the publisher publishes. (1) The exit label needs consecutive-edition diffs; INEGI makes only the current edition downloadable (measured; the ~12 documented semiannual editions 2019-2024 are replaced, not archived). One snapshot = no second observation = no label = no windows. (2) Secondary, recorded as a comparison rather than the primary reason: the entity-exit family is already carried on the bench by companies-house-company-exit (GB) - even with historical editions, a second same-family task would need an explicit operator decision that the bench wants two exit tasks (same reasoning as the air4thai-pm25-exceedance park). (3) Licence is NOT a blocker (INEGI free use with attribution, terms quoted). Not a rejection: nothing about the source itself disqualifies the task if a historical archive appears.
next_action: Unpark conditions (any one): (1) a verifiable archive of >=4 historical DENUE editions appears on an INEGI download channel - probe with the PK-magic check, never HTTP status (this publisher soft-404s); (2) an institutional mirror (national library, university archive, or INEGI's own historical-data service) serves historical editions whose row counts verify against the published per-edition totals; (3) the operator decides the bench wants a second entity-exit task AND such a source is found. If reopened: first probe is a known-event fixture (a large surviving retailer chain must survive across editions) because ID churn - not exit - reads as absence; INEGI states the ID is the cross-version linking key but that claim must be measured before absence-as-exit is trusted.
